avis.titre: THIS PRODUCT NEEDS PULLED OFF THE SHELVES
avis.texte: This product needs pulled completely off the shelves! It is NOT SAFE to put on your face! I wore this and applied to to my forehead, nose and cheeks and the sunscreen made its way into my eyes when i sweat. Now, my eyes burn so bad i want to rip them out!! If youre looking for a good product that ACTUALLY WORKS and doesnt blind you, get the Anua face SPF. Its great!! This Sum Bum product is TRASH!

It works, but it smells very strongly of industrial chemical paint. I could still smell it hours after applying. It's very unnerving to put something on you that smells like it should go on a wall, and only be used in a well ventilated area. So, I will not be using it ever again.

avis.titre: The only sunblock I can use
avis.texte: This has been the only sunblock I can use on my face. My new moisturizer doesn't have sunblock in it. Sun Bum absorbs great, it doesn't smell like other sunblock and it helps with my makeup application going on smoother.

avis.titre: I couldn't see for hours after using this product
avis.texte: I used this product on my face in vegas a couple weeks ago and after i gor out of the pool my eyes started to buen incredubly bad and i was unable to open them. My eyes also got incredibly sensitive to light. I would not recommend this product.

I like this sunscreen alot but it makes my skin feel extremely greasy. The times I have put this sunscreen on it has been really great at protecting my skin and it has a slight smell but i smells good to me.

avis.titre: Great if you want your eyes to burn all day
avis.texte: I hate this sunscreen. I've tried so many times and every time I'm left with burning watering stinging eyes. I can't even keep them open at work. I've even tried mixing with a moisturizer. A facial sunscreen that can't be within 3 ft of your eyes? No

avis.titre: My favorite ever!! I have sensitive skin
avis.texte: I have sensitive and acne prone skin when using the wrong products. I am also super sensitive to the sun now more than ever (I usually burn anyway) since I take medications that make me extra sensitive to the sun. I was in the sun all day long (tanning) on vacation, and did not get burned at all like normal - and I had a nice tan. This is my absolute favorite sunscreen! It feels so great and lightweight on the skin and makes my skin look so glowy and healthy. I wear it with and without makeup and it always looks great. I rub it all over my entire face and yes if you do get it directly in your eye it burns a little bit but that has only happened once using this every day (1x a day or more). I absolutely recommend this!!

It works well. Stings your eyes, but so do most products when they get in your eyes. I would recommend reapplying at the 80 min mark like it says on the bottle, especially if you have been in water or sweating. I thought it felt slightly greasy on my face but I also have oily skin.
Ive always loved this sunscreen on myself seeing the reviews make me scared since I just bought this for my mom. Honestly just be careful. it doesnt make my eyes water or anything.

avis.titre: Figured I'd give it a try
avis.texte: Goes on thick and white but absorbs nicely and leaves my skin feeling soft. Just don't put too close to ur eyes bc it def does irritate the eyes. Haven't gotten to test it on sunny day yet since it's winter here. But so far I like it!

It abosrbs nicely and doesnt leave a white cast but it makes my face look really greasy. Its also extremely irritating to my eyes. My eyes are watering constantly and it makes me look like im convulsingly crying 24/7. Its not worth it and im just using it for my hands and neck now.

avis.titre: "reverse sunburn" red in areas I USED the product
avis.texte: I've had bad sunburns before, but never after applying and reapplying a sunscreen! Wearing a hat all day mostly saved my face, but my shoulders, back, and chest where I used the product are now CRISPY. There's a line from where mid-shoulder I did not apply. I also got bumps and whiteheads on my face where I applied the cream across nose, cheeks, chin and forehead (but I have sun-exposure related skin issues, so to be fair, it might not be 100% the product). I am in contact with the company to see if I got a bad batch, but beware.

avis.titre: Great Face Protection I will buy again!
avis.texte: Love this brand of sun protection but i had not tried the face formula before - took it straight to the beach and it was great, stayed on long, not greasy but really worked well. Applied liberally to face, my husband's bald head and toes - Will buy again.

avis.titre: It smells bad, not for darker tan or brown skin.
avis.texte: Its great and all, but it doesnt smell great and doesnt blend all to well with tan skin. But it gets the job done and doesnt leave a greasy residue.

avis.titre: My sensitive skin loves this stuff!
avis.texte: I have been using this Sun Bum face sunscreen for years now. I have fair and very sensitive skin (I also have rosacea) and have to be careful about the products I use. I have been using this one every day for a long time! This lotion absorbs easily, protects my skin, doesn't irritate it, has no scent, and doesn't interfere with my makeup. I truly love it, and now that I'm in my 40's have started using it on my neck and chest. I get lots of compliments on my skin, and this is part of the reason. I was really surprised to see some people had bad reactions to this product, so I just wanted to leave a review with my experience with my skin type. I love this stuff and will always use it.

avis.titre: Overall, mediocre product and would save money.
avis.texte: While i do mostly love and adore sunbum's products, this one is just not it for me. This and really any one of this brand's sunscreens that say "Face" on it like for example "Face 50" tend to be runny. I feel as if this product feels really oily on my skin and looks bad. It makes ur skin glowy, but it's not truly worth it. There other sunscreens are much better and work more efficiently like their regular 15, 30, 50, and 70 sunscreens or their Roll-On SPF 50 sunscreen. Luckily i didn't experience any break-outs, or rashes with this product, but it's still not great and Sunbum can do better.
I was driving home, 9 hour trip, and this got into my eyes and they were burning and watering - legit crying - for 5 hours straight. Nothing helped. The absolute worst product.
DO NOT BUY this sunscreen i only used it one day and the next i had a allergic reaction to it gave me a rash

I love this! When i don't wear it i seem to get more breakouts. I knocked a star off for the packaging. the packaging kind of sucks, if the product gets on the lid it will peel away the "wood" look. And creates a mess on the lid

love this product but if you get it anywhere near your eyes it will burn for hours, washing them with water doesn't help, im currently on my couch, tears pouring from my eyes waiting for benedryl to kick in, only happens sometimes, but not worth it!
So far so good. There is no white cast and it goes on very well.

I have been using this for a couple of months now and im surprised at all the negative reviews. I have not once felt any burning in my eyes. Just maybe dont put it around your eyes ? I also have dry sensistive eczema prone skin and to me it feels very hydrating. I even use it under my makeup and have not had any problems. I will be repurchasing

avis.titre: My go-to sunscreen when I'll be outside
avis.texte: I have always burned rather easily. I have always applied sunscreen before heading outside, but recently was convinced to wear it every day. I use a higher end sunscreen for day-to-day, mostly because I like the feel of it and thus I remember to apply it. However, I wanted something cheaper for when I'm headed out on walks, mowing, gardening, etc. I use Sun Bum products for that. It takes me 3 hours to mow my lawn. I need to apply sunscreen at least twice in that time, no matter the brand, or I burn. I use Sun Bum Face on my face before heading out. I never burn on my face, and it doesn't feel like I have sunscreen on at all. I have not experienced the eye stinging that others have. I've had such a good experience with this, I buy it for my kids too (all old enough to apply themselves) and none of them have had any stinging, or burned skin when using this.

I didnt get this product in my eyes, but after about 30 minutes one eye started getting irritated, then 30 min later the other eye, tried eyedrops, medicated eyedrops, my eyes swelled and were watering so much that i couldnt see and was in a lot of pain. had to take a makeup wipe to take it off, had to put my head under the sink to rise my eyes out, then eyedrops again and was fine.
I agree with others, it burned my eyes (and my husband's as well) so it's a big NO using this while swimming.

I have been loyal to this product for years, and will continue to do so. It has a great price point, it melts into the skin, it lays beautifully under make up, it moisturizes the skin, and of course, its very effective in protecting against the sun. My only criticism is it can sting if you get it in your eyes, just be careful when applying. While I feel for people that have had allergic reactions after using this product, there is a reason why you always patch test, people! Don't play around with your face/skin y'all!

I have very sensitive/ acne prone skin. This sunscreen works amazing for me. I had tried pretty much every sunscreen out there and I would always get a reaction or break out really bad. This really is the best face sunscreen. If you do get breakouts or clogged pores with this one I would really make sure you're getting all of it off of your face. I use Tony Moly Chok Chok cleansing water and than I wash my face and no issues. Please dont ever discontinue this!!

I avoided my eye area and it ran into my eyes or something. I also have sensitive skin and made my skin very red after a few days of use. By the end of the day my eyes were so tired and heavy from use. It is very run and it look and feels greasy on the face.

Im sure we've all seen the sunscreen TikToks and this one covered really well, so i bought it. I put it on and went about my day. About an hour later my left eye started watering and my left nostril started running. It just wouldnt stop. I live in Ohio and it's peak allergy season so I took some Claritin and it just wouldnt stop. By 9pm, about 9 hours after putting it on, I was constantly rubbing my eye and wiping my nose. I thought I just had a cold and decided to go to bed. I washed my face and did my night routine and went to bed and it all stopped. It was this stuff. I'll give it another try and maybe keep it farther away from my eyes and see how it goes, but if it happens again, I'll take it back. I really do like everything else about it.

I've been using this sunscreen for about 3 years now and it is by far my favorite. I struggle to find sunscreens that dont leave a whitecast and this product does just that. For context, I'm a Fitzpatrick 4 skin tone. The SPF 70 verison is way too sticky, this one is just the right balance of glowy but not greasy. Only negative is that sometimes it does burn my eyes, but it's kind of rare.

avis.titre: didn't irritate my eyed like other reviewers
avis.texte: I really like this sunscreen. It applies well and absorbs quickly, leaving the same glowy shine I like from my moisturizers. It has a slight scent, but since there's no fragrance added, that only comes from the ingredients. Its not strong and doesn't bother me. I have light skin, but have not noticed a white cast. I was a little nervous since so many people reported their eyes burning, but I didn't notice any irritation. I will probably purchase one of the bigger bottles for better value, and keep this one for travel!

Loved this when it came out like 4 years ago, wore it for a 2 week outdoor vacation and my skin was well protected. Since then I've been trying other sunscreens but remembered how much I liked this so now I'm back. Too bad others had bad reviews on this, I personally loved it.
Burns my eyes if I get the sunscreen anywhere near it, is extremely greasy and rubs off easily and the texture is very runny

I've been using this for a while and I wanted to like it so much because it doesn't leave a white cast and that really is the only reason I'm leaving any stars. But this stuff BURNS your eyes if you accidentally rub them and you'll be tearing up for at least 10 minutes. No bueno. It also looks super greasy and unflattering, do not recommend this as an every day sunscreen.

I've been through two and a half tubes of this sunscreen. I liked everything that's listed on the front, and that it did not leave any white cast. The biggest problems for me was that 1) it constantly pulled throughout the day, no matter how well I rubbed it in or how well I had exfoliated the night before and that 2) if you get this in your eyes it is BAD. Really really bad. Your eyes will be red and crying for the next hour and a half. It was fine I suppose for the price, but I will be using the remaining half on my neck and be moving on to a different sunscreen.

I am going to return this because it pulls like crazy. I have tried rubbing it and tapping it on the skin and nothing works. It is super oily so if you have oily skin like me, this isn't for you. It has a horrible white cast and sits really bad under make up. However, it does protect my skin well, but that's the only pro I can think of.
I love this lotion but it stings my eyes so bad I really can't wear it. I am bummed because it feels so nice on my dry, acne prone skin.. it also did not cause any breakouts.
Gave this a try and OMG is this just oil?? Made my eyes sting and face break out, if I touch my face my fingers look like I just dipped them in cooking oil. DO NOT BUY!

Only writing a review to say it does burn. No sweating on my face but somehow got in my eyes (probably because I used two layers) and stung so bad. I drove home from work with watering eyes the entire time with no relief even after flushing my eyes multiple times and cleansing my skin. I will use up but fully agree to use a mineral sunscreen around eyes first.
I'm allergic to the sun so it being such a high spf, I love it. I'm a woman of color and it doesn't leave a ugly white cast, that's the plus!

avis.titre: um .. no. drying and allergic reaction
avis.texte: i thought that this product would be a great sunscreen for a day on the boat but... i woke up with my face and eyes completely swollen. i guess i had an allergic reaction because i have sensitive skin but i've never had one like this before... awful
Such a good facial sunscreen. I have super sensitive skin and typically only use neutragena*my spelling may be wrong* but this is amazing!

I love this facial sunscreen! It's hydrating but not greasy. I find it very similar to Supergoop. Very reasonable price point. Does not leave a white cast. Works great under makeup. (Do not apply near eyes.) I also use in my face every time I go to the beach 🏖 and it has worked great (I burn easily and turn red in the sun like a lobster 🦞).

I am tan and it's so hard finding something affordable. It goes on and does not leave a white cast which is my biggest thing! I go through sunscreen a lot due to work so it's nice I don't have to break the bank on something I like.

avis.titre: I listened to my Ulta person and she was spot on
avis.texte: I have dry skin but cannot stand to look like an oil spill from the spf. I asked if there was ANYTHING that gave me spf, no white cast, and not look greasy. She said I use this. No white cast and dried to the touch.

this sunscreen isn't worth getting AT ALL. I have dry, sensitive skin and this caused my skin to get a rash all over. it was hot and extremely itchy. keep that in mind if you still choose to order this product.

avis.titre: Definitely the go to for a routine
avis.texte: One thing I liked about this product is that the scent was little to none and it had a sheer glow with it. It didn't dry out my face either or leave a weird feeling. Love it!!
Works fine. Easy to apply, thin, but a bit greasy feeling. No scent. If it gets into eyes it can sting. I do not regret purchasing, but I will be looking for something better.
It gives white cast and if it gets near eyes it burns ready bad.

I have attempted to use this sunscreen twice. The first time was applied how I normally would. It immediately caused my eyes to water and sting. The second time I avoided my eyes and, though it took a few minutes longer, the same thing happened.

I've used this for about a week consistently. Living in a tropical climate means that I need to be super consistent with applying sunscreen and making it a part of my routine. However this is made my face so extremely dry- I normally don't suffer with dry skin. I have now had to use an at home micro dermabrasion tool to exfoliate my skin because of how DRYING this is. It's a horrible formula going to be returning

I genuinly never write reviews on products, but this suncreen burned my eyes like no sunscreen has ever before. I wasn't even sweating. And I feel like this is insufficient for a face sunscreen becuase you have to apply around your eyes.

avis.titre: i like it, but my eyes don't
avis.texte: it's definitely a solid sunscreen, and when I don't know what to pick, i typically return to this one. that being said, i would opt for a different sunscreen to use around your eyes if you choose this one, since it always ends up getting into my eyes and stings really uncomfortably. i like to use it on my cheeks, forehead, neck and chest, and pair it with a mineral sunscreen on the eyes :)
On vacation in Jamaica. Tried this for the first time. My eyes sting horribly. Ugh. Won't use again.

It's a shame this stings my eyes so badly because it really is a very nice, elegant formulation for a high SPF and a very good price point. But I can't wear this anywhere near my eyes, which isn't ideal for a sunscreen marketed as being for the face. So much stinging and my eyes were watering for literally hours, and the skin around my eyes was red and sensitive for hours after that. It has a somewhat dewy finish which I like for my dry skin. It is pretty lightweight and absorbs quickly. I'm going to use the rest of the bottle on my body I guess, or with a sunscreen stick around the eyes.

avis.titre: Perfect for break out prone skin
avis.texte: I have used the regular Sun Bum 50 SPF lotion for my face in the past and it worked great. The only problem I had was stinging around my eyes. This lotion doesn't seem to cause that issue and it doesn't cause me to break out like all of the other lotions I have tried!
The consistency is amazing. It glides on the skin so well and doesn't look greasy on the face. My go to face sunscreen forever.

If you hate oily, greasy sunscreen then you should try this. It does have a white cast for the first few minutes after application but it leaves you feeling moisturized but not greasy which I hate in a sunscreen

I have dry/combination skin (oily t-zone but incredibly dry elsewhere), and this was the first sunscreen that I used that didn't break me out or dry out my skin. The only issue that I've had with this is pilling. This usually happens at the end of the day, or when I wear masks for long periods of time. My sister and my dad say that it gets in their eyes and burns, but I've never had that problem.

Used this product for the first time. Within minutes my eyes felt like I had put jalapeños in them and my eyes were slits from being so swollen. Tried rinsing and eye drops and Benedryl and nothing helped. Just had to wait about 8 hours for the pain to subside. Never again.

I'm very confused about these negative reviews. I am no suncare expert, but if it feels greasy you should probably use a cleanser of some sort or maybe apply less. Sunscreen is not the only skincare you need. It is important, but it is only one part of the process. It doesn't appear to have a white cast, feels pretty light and comfortable on my skin, and is inside the range of my budget. My only complaint is that it pills if I apply too much, but that's mostly my fault of course.

Even though it kind of smells like glue, in my opinion, I would not mind it if it absorbed better into my skin. I can taste it after applying it even if I don't spread it around my mouth. It doesn't leave a white cast but does feel chalky on my face and finger tips.

Performs well under my Nars foundation & that's all I care about. Does not find its way into my eyes and lips the way la roche milk does. I will be purchasing again once I'm out. It does not roll, does not turn white, it does what it needs to do. Skin feels smooth once it is on

I wanted something specifically for my face when I am hiking and this works well. I am fair skinned and burn easily. I reapply this many times when I'm out for extended periods of time, and I have not burned using this. I almost always also wear a hat, however. I think this is good for the price and doesn't dry my skin out or cause breakouts
The sunscreen sits comfortably on the face and doesn't leave a cast or anything but when I wash it off with a gentle face wash it stings the skin under my eyes. Not pleasant.

I LOVE this sunscreen! It has been one of the best ones I've ever used. I have oily skin, so it's a plus that I can apply it under my makeup & it does not leave me a greasy feeling. It goes well with my skincare routine. It it a little bit runny & a little goes a long way.

Oh my gosh I know this sounds dramatic but I wish I could give it negative stars. I've been using this stuff for two days and now I have a rash all over my face and neck. Maybe it reacted weird with my moisturizer, and if that they should put warnings on chemicals that you shouldn't combine it with. I use the cerave nighttime ultra lightweight moisturizer and have been for about the past year. The first day I started using this sunscreen I was fine, but now my face and neck is covered in little itchy red bumps. I've never had acne or anything, I'm actually known for my great skin. So, if you see this review, DO NOT BUY THIS!!!

It's a solid, affordable sunscreen. If you have sensitive skin, it might burn, and if it gets in your eyes, it stings so bad. It does look kinda greasy on its own, but it looks fine under makeup and doesn't cause separation or anything.

avis.titre: one of the best sunscreens under makeup
avis.texte: i have super oily skin and i live in texas (100°F all the time) so it's already difficult to wear makeup without it sliding away and separating but sunscreen always makes it 10x worse. ive had the least problems with this one. under makeup, it looks like i'm not even wearing sunscreen. but make sure you're careful around the eyes and you wash your hands after putting it on, this stuff BURNS if it gets in your eyes and it takes forever for that feeling to go away.
its not a bad sunscreen but if you plan on wearing makeup on top, it will peel.

avis.titre: The BEST face sunscreen, no oily shine
avis.texte: I don't wear foundation, so I like a sunscreen that is more matte for a natural face, this is the one! I was really surprised by the negative comments, one being eye sting. The only time I have had an issue with that is from actual eye cream migrating. Also the formula is not thick, it rubs in great.

I love this sunscreen. There is no white cast, and it dries matte. I have oily skin, and this works perfectly for me. A lot of reviews speak of burning eyes which I haven't experienced but are you supposed to apply this product near your eyes? I don't think so. There are sunscreens specific for the eye area, but this isn't one of them.
I love this sunscreen. It's super thin and easy to rub in and feels good on my skin

I have had a great experience using this sunscreen. I have noticed an improvement in my skins health with regular use. My skin is moisturized all day. I have less sun spots or dark spots on my face and neck. I have dry skin, eczema, some allergies, hormonal cystic acne, and overall sensitive skin and I have very fair skin. So I have to be very picky about what I use on my skin and I really want to avoid sun burns and skin damage. Despite all of this, the Sun Bum face spf 50 has been meeting all of my needs in a face sunscreen. It occasionally can sting my eyes, not bad enough to be a deal breaker for me considering all the ways that it works so well for me. I would recommend to a friend for sure.

avis.titre: No white cast but it burns my eyes
avis.texte: This sunscreen has a nice texture and doesn't leave a white cast for me, but after a little it burns my eyes a lot and my eyes get watering

I wore this sunscreen while out in the hot FL sun running my errands. Like one does, I applied the sunscreen all over my face including my eye area and it did not take long till my eyes were watering to the point it looked like I was crying. This sunscreen made my eyes so uncomfortable I tried rinsing/wiping it off but the stinging sensation was still there even a few hours after application. Needless to say I will not continue to use this product and I will not be repurchasing.
My husband and I both tried this and it made our faces burn, especially around the eyes. It had a chemical smell that was so overwhelming and gross.

I've been using it for years, every day. I have sensitive, oily, and acne prone skin. this face lotion doesn't make me breakout & my skin doesn't look oily. I wish they'd make an spf 30 version because I want some sun tan on my face.

I have been struggling to find a good spf sunscreen and I feel like I have found the one. I don't know how it irritates other peoples eyes cuz it doesn't irritate mine. I apply around the orbital area but not where my under eye is. Anyways, it's lightweight and a lil oily but it mattes over the 15 min mark. I have normal to oily and dry skin and the sunscreen is great even after I apply moisturizer. So Good luck!

Amazed how many similar comments there are! Why haven't they changed the formula? I love this sunscreen because it doesn't break me out like sooo many others I've tried over the years. BUT it gets into my eyes and burns so badly, all day my eyes are watering and burning. So awful

I really liked their tinted face sunscreen! But it was half the size for a higher price, so I thought I would try this BUT NO IT BURNS MY EYES SO BAD Currently resting a wet cloth on my eyelids. I wasn't even sweating, I was just sitting in my living room and my eyes started burning, I wouldn't even attempt to use this while swimming omg Fail of a product for this to be advertised for the face! Will probably finish the bottle on my neck/chest but definitely not buying again

Skin background: Oily, Acne Prone, Sensitive Review: I was SUPER skeptical to buy this because I saw some people's reviews about this sunblock burning their skin. I have really sensitive skin myself and other sunblocks break me out. I decided to try this one out and I LOVEEEEE it. No regrets what so ever!! Didn't burn my skin, does not feel icky on my skin, didnt break me out (woohoo!) and not one sunburn after swimming for hours! I wore this sunblock in Las Vegas in 117 degree weather, went swimming, and it worked amazing for me. Keep in mind everyone's skin is different and what doesn't work for others doesn't mean it won't work for you. Don't let the comments steer you away! Works great under makeup with some setting powder too. Love love love!

avis.titre: Love it! Just a tiny complaint
avis.texte: I love this face sunscreen, it distributes very well on my face and feels really good! It hasn't made me break out and it feels a bit heavy, but only like a moisturizer would. My only complaint is that it leaves a tiny bit of a white cast which is almost invisible. I'm super pale so it doesn't affect me haha, but if you're looking for no white cast at all, maybe don't buy this. However, I can barely feel it once I put it on and let it sit for a while, and my other skin care products love it!

I purchased this product because I wanted a reef safe sunscreen and I like this product for that reason. It has some other benefits, but not much differing it from other sunscreens. The MAJOR con for this product, though, is that it burns the beep out of my eyes. I won't put it anywhere near my eyes and they still burn. Even afterwards, if the product is on my hands and I so much as graze my eyebrow, it will burn my eyes. I don't like it for this reason.

Wanted to start using sunscreen since summer is coming up but everytime I apply it to my face it burns my eyes. At first I thought I had an eyelash but after reapplying a few times it really is just the cream. Funny thing is I made sure after the first time to apply not close to my eyes/not to touch my face and it still happened. I don't recommend :c

avis.titre: I would buy this product over and over
avis.texte: I would use this product on my face over and over again. So.... far no cons yet.
I do not have sensitive skin or eyes and this sunscreen burns my eyes terribly everytime I use it. I would never repurchase this.

avis.titre: Ive been in pain for 3 hours
avis.texte: I usually like sun Bum but I realize I've only ever used it on my body. I applied this to my face, not near my eyes, and it made its way there with a vengeance. I have been rinsing my eyes for hours, using eye drops, closing them, I'm trying everything. They're swollen shut. I'm so tired of sunscreen doing this to me but this is the worst reaction I've had. I liked the price of this sunscreen compared to most others but I'm regretting it so much. If you use this find a way to keep it out of your eyes. I would especially keep this away from kids :( it did soak into my skin nicely, didn't feel greasy, made me look moisturized and Matte. And swollen and destroyed.

avis.titre: Meh performance but does the job
avis.texte: I use this as the last step of my skincare routine in the morning. While it does protect my skin from the sun, it's very greasy feeling and never really dries or absorbs into the skin. It stings the absolute frick out of your eyes so I wouldn't recommend putting it all over your eyes. If you like the dewy look, then this is great. But for people with acne like me, it kinda just makes it look dirty.
Blended into the skin nicely, worked well under makeup. Only con is that it burns soo bad if it gets into my eyes

I was initially pleased with this product. It absorbs quickly and doesn't leave a white cast. It provides good protection from the sun. But every time I apply makeup over top, it pills up and leaves my face looking flaky.

I love this sunscreen. I have very sensitive skin and have trouble finding products that don't irritate my face. I've been wearing this sunscreen daily for the past month and a half and my skin is doing great. My only issue is that I have to avoid the area around my eyes otherwise it can sting and irritate them, but a lot of things irritate my eyes, like most makeup removers so I'm not surprised. The sunscreen absorbs into the skin fairly quickly, about 10 minutes before I no longer look greasy.

My kids love spending time in the pool & at the beach but hate the feeling of heavy, occlusive sunscreens on their faces. This sunscreen allows me to keep their faces protected and keep them happy at the same time. Great job Sun Bum!!!

I will start off by saying that I have never had acne and I don't really consider my skin to be too sensitive. However, this product did some weird things to my face. I used the product maybe two times before I began to break out all over--which looked more like a rash than pimples. It also kind of burned when I applied. I wish I had listened to other reviews before buying. I will be okay with purchasing something a bit more pricey after using this product.
Love this sunscreen. It is very watery but doesn't feel heavy and absorbs well. Had a sunscreen smell but I like that!
I love how I applied this it felt like this other sunscreen I used to use! And this one is safe for oceans
I use everyday. I have sensitive, oily skin & it doesn't break me out or make me Shiney. LOVE IT!!

avis.titre: rash all over face & stings eyes
avis.texte: i just used this as a regular sunscreen for the beach. after 2 days of using it and not really paying attention, i noticed that my skin was starting to develop a weird red rash on my chin and cheeks. i didn't put two and two together until a day or two later and then stopped using it, it's going away now. it also stung my eyes really bad in the water & out, to the point of not being able to open my eyes fully. super disappointed :/

Sunscreen was great at first then I went into the sun and it became very oily and actually dripped into my eyes and stung like crazy and wouldn't stop. I like the texture of it so I was really disappointed that I didn't love it :( would not repurchase.

avis.titre: Sad to see so many bad reviews
avis.texte: I have super sensitive and reactive skin. Most, if not all, mineral sunscreens make my skin hot and itchy and most chemical ones make my skin burn. This is the only chemical sunscreen I have found that goes on with zero pain. It smells like sunscreen but I do not care because it doesn't cause me pain. For the affordable price I'd say try it even if you are sensitive because if you end up not liking it use it on your hands and arms.
it broke my out in a horrible rash all over my face also made my eyes burn don't not purchase this sunscreen it's not worth it literally broke out it the worst rash ever.

This is a great daily sunscreen. It goes on clear and is NOT oily. While it says 'scent free', it still smells like sunscreen. I don't think they can get around the smell, but I personally would love an odor-free sunscreen.

Use this on my face, except around the eyes. I'm white, and this doesn't make me look like a vampire. Really noticeable gluelike scent. Runnier consistency allows for easy application. Feels smooth after application. Burns eyes like a mf
SPF is a must on skincare .you must wear everyday .this stuff is great

I applied it after my morning skincare routine. First off, it was very runny and it felt very greasy on the face. I decided to ignore this. The next thing I noticed was that throughout the day it would somehow find its way into my eyes and burned for a couple minutes. At times it was so horrible that I had to run to the bathroom. This was essentially even worse when exercising because all sweat did was bring it even more often into my eyes. The one thing that I appreciate about this sunscreen is that it did not leave such a horrible white cast as other brands of sunscreen (i.e cerave). Currently looking for a new sunscreen.

If I could give this -500 stars I would. I usually never write reviews but this was awful. Do not buy. My skin was breakout free and moisturized prior. Two days after use, my skin felt easily irritated and was red. 5 days later and I had to stop using the product, my skin is now peeling off and hurts to touch. So incredibly frustrated.

The first day I used this sunscreen I didn't know i should be avoiding it around my eyes so i just applied it all over my face and then it started burning my eyes like crazy. I really liked the texture and the not super greasy feel of it so the next day I tried avoiding the eye area as much as i can. It was fine and I did reapply after couple of hours but later in the afternoon I felt that burning sensation again but not as crazy so I was thinking maybe even if I work around it, it will still get close to my eyes later on. I'm still giving this a fair chance and not going to put it to waste. I am just at home lately anyways that I can easily wash my eyes area when the burning starts again. But I am scared to use this when I need to be out. Haha. Again, i love everything about it except the eye burning part of it.

I bought this and thought it was a great consistency no greasy residue but it turned out to be horrible. The next day I broke out in a rash on my face. My under eyes were swollen and I had splotchiness and bumps all over. My face was so itchy and I literally only used it twice. Will never buy this product or any sun bum products again. Also I recently just used this so hopefully my rash will go away but I currently still have it. So frustrating!!! If I could rate this a negative star I would!

I wanted to love this so much! I love that it is light weight, but unfortunately it DOES get shiny and oily throughout the day.... much more than my other spf's do. I absolutely love the value and I wish more sunscreens can be like this in the value department considering it's the most important skincare step. Didn't have any complains about the strong alcohol/sunscreen scent till I double cleansed and the scent irritated my eyes. Obviously sunscreen can be put on the eyes and not in (duh) but I have never had this problem with any other sunscreen. So for that reason especially, I will be returning this because I don't wanna burn my eyes out after every shower. Will try the tinted spf though!
It's very runny and comes out fast. It makes my face oily and I feel sticky all day. I just feel like it's gonna drip off my face.

I always hated putting on sunscreen when I was younger but this turned my opinion around. Normal sunscreen to me was always oil and heavy on my face. But this Sun Bum sunscreen is above and beyond. This product is so lightweight but protects your face from the sun. There is barley any scent which makes it an amazing product for those with certain smells that bother them.

I have really sensitive dry skin with lots and lots of acne scars. I love that this has SPF 50 for everyday but the real magic is how this makes your skin look. It gives a super healthy looking glow. I really hate my skin but this gives me such a nice effect I hate it a little less when I wear it

saw a girl on tiktok recommend this. worked fine for a couple hours but then my eyes started burning like crazy. will be returning. wow i really don't recommend this at all. should have a huge warning to not get anywhere close to eyes or even people with slightly sensitive skin should stay far away.
It super light weight and it makes my skin happy. Its doesn't have any smell to it and it came at a good price. Overall definitely would buy this again!
This BURNED my eyes all day long and gave me a horrible allergic reaction. Itchy, painful, red and swollen. DO NOT recommend!

I like how the consistency is kind of water and it easily blends into the skin. I feel I have to mention a few things based on the reviews I've seen on this page: -don't get any sunscreen in your eyes!! No sunscreen is meant to be fine going into your eyes and it will burn. "Face sunscreen" usually just means it won't make you break out or be too heavy because face skin is more sensitive than your body. does not mean rub into your eyes! -If you had such a bad reaction that it sent you to the hospital, you're allergic to something in it. That's not going to happen to everyone. You might want to figure out what it was that you had a reaction to so you don't buy other sunscreens with the same ingredient. That said, it works fine for me. I like the sun bum brand and wear this particular sunscreen everyday.

avis.titre: the best drugstore sunscreen! TRUST ME
avis.texte: This sunscreen leaves no white cast. Its not greasy either its very lightweight and it does its job. The texture is very runny though. Stop buying sunscreen from Neutrogena!! Yall are sleeping on this sunscreen for real!

avis.titre: My eyes are burning so bad as i type this
avis.texte: I applied a normal amount throughout the day and I thought it was an okay texture. No white cast whatsoever. I noticed though that if I barely rubbed my eye or touched near it it would somehow end up in my eye and start stinging like crazy. I've been waiting to go home for hours now and the burning still won't go away. This is the fifth time it's happened and it happens every time I use this sunscreen without fail. It is not meant for your face like the bottle says. My right eye is red and is tearing up so bad someone thought I was crying. Don't waste your time.

This works well with and without makeup. Not greasy looking like some. This is my daily sunscreen, but protected by face really well at the beach over the summer. As with any sunscreen, this will burn your eyes if you get it in them. I apply right under the eye and top part of the upper eyelid with no irritation issues.
